scenarios.name: Retain independent panel visibility across ribbon tabs

scenario_steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left with Modify visible
Navigate is visible on the View ribbon
the user hides Modify through the direct panel selector
the Modify panel disappears from the 3D Model ribbon
the user switches to the View ribbon
the user returns to the 3D Model ribbon
the user opens the direct panel selector
the user selects Modify in the panel selector
the Modify panel returns to the 3D Model ribbon
the panel selector remains open with Modify checked
